A Sdiag OpenMx Matrix

Source: R/mxHelper-sdiag-mx-matrix.R
MxHelperSdiagMxMatrix.Rd

Builds a p by p strictly lower triangular matrix as an OpenMx matrix of type "Sdiag". With vec = TRUE, it also builds a column vector (<name>_vec) of the free elements, labelled with their bracket labels, so that they can be extracted as a vector. The arguments are checked first; the internal version, without checks, is the one other projects copy.

Usage

MxHelperSdiagMxMatrix(
  p,
  free_val,
  values,
  lbound_val,
  ubound_val,
  vec,
  row,
  col,
  name
)

Arguments

p

Positive integer. Number of rows and columns of the square matrix.

free_val

Logical vector or matrix, or NULL. Which elements are free parameters. A single value is recycled; NULL means all free.

values

Numeric vector or matrix, or NULL. Starting values. A single value is recycled; NULL means zeros.

lbound_val

Numeric vector or matrix, or NULL. Lower bounds of the free elements. A single value is recycled; NULL or NA means none.

ubound_val

Numeric vector or matrix, or NULL. Upper bounds of the free elements. A single value is recycled; NULL or NA means none.

vec

Logical. If TRUE, also return the bracket labels of the free elements, for a column vector of free parameters.

row

Character vector or NULL. Row names of the matrix. If NULL, i_1, ..., i_m.

col

Character vector or NULL. Column names of the matrix. If NULL, j_1, ..., j_n.

name

Character string. Name of the matrix or algebra.

Value

Returns a named list of OpenMx matrices: the matrix name, and with vec = TRUE and at least one free element, the column vector <name>_vec.

See also

Other Strictly Lower Triangular Matrix Functions: MxHelperSdiagBound(), MxHelperSdiagFree(), MxHelperSdiagLabels(), MxHelperSdiagPrepMatrices(), MxHelperSdiagValues()

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

MxHelperSdiagMxMatrix(
  p = 2,
  free_val = NULL,
  values = NULL,
  lbound_val = NULL,
  ubound_val = NULL,
  vec = TRUE,
  row = NULL,
  col = NULL,
  name = "beta"
)
#> $beta
#> SdiagMatrix 'beta' 
#> 
#> $labels
#>     j_1        j_2
#> i_1 NA         NA 
#> i_2 "beta_2_1" NA 
#> 
#> $values
#>     j_1 j_2
#> i_1   0   0
#> i_2   0   0
#> 
#> $free
#>       j_1   j_2
#> i_1 FALSE FALSE
#> i_2  TRUE FALSE
#> 
#> $lbound: No lower bounds assigned.
#> 
#> $ubound: No upper bounds assigned.
#> 
#> 
#> $beta_vec
#> FullMatrix 'beta_vec' 
#> 
#> $labels
#>           beta_vec   
#> beta[2,1] "beta[2,1]"
#> 
#> $values
#>           beta_vec
#> beta[2,1]        0
#> 
#> $free: No free parameters.
#> 
#> $lbound: No lower bounds assigned.
#> 
#> $ubound: No upper bounds assigned.
#> 
#>
